addressLine1.description: Street and building number. Required to issue.
addressLine1.label: Address line 1

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Defaults to PL.
country.label: Country

sellerName.description: Registered company name (Podmiot1) printed on the invoice. Required to issue.
sellerName.label: Seller legal name

sellerNip.description: 10-digit Polish tax identifier of the issuing seller. Required to issue invoices.
sellerNip.label: Seller NIP

ksefConnectionConfig.bankAccountLength: Bank account number must be 10-34 characters (per the FA(3) NrRB format).
ksefConnectionConfig.countryIso2: Country must be a 2-letter ISO code (e.g. PL).
ksefConnectionConfig.exemptionTextRequired: Enter the legal grounds the exemption cites.
ksefConnectionConfig.nipChecksum: Seller NIP has an invalid checksum.
ksefConnectionConfig.paymentTermMax: Payment term must be at most 999 days.
ksefConnectionConfig.paymentTermWhole: Payment term must be a non-negative whole number of days.
ksefConnectionConfig.postalCode: Postal code must use the PL format NN-NNN.
ksefConnectionConfig.skontoAmountRequired: Discount amount is required when discount conditions are set.
ksefConnectionConfig.skontoConditionsRequired: Discount conditions are required when a discount amount is set.

ksefCredentialsPanel.description: Stored securely on the server. Rotate to replace the KSeF token / seal reference without restarting the API.
ksefCredentialsPanel.label: Authentication secret

toast.description: The new KSeF authentication secret is now in use.
toast.title: Credentials rotated

ksefFa3View.verificationHint: Scan to verify this invoice against the KSeF system.

ksefInvoiceCorrectionFlow.gridLinesRequired: Change at least one line’s quantity or price before issuing a correction.
ksefInvoiceCorrectionFlow.issuedBody: The correcting document was submitted to KSeF.
ksefInvoiceCorrectionFlow.lineDeltaRequired: Each line must specify a new quantity and/or a new price.
ksefInvoiceCorrectionFlow.linesRequired: At least one line with a line number is required.
ksefInvoiceCorrectionFlow.note: A KOR document corrects quantity and/or price per line. KSeF assigns a clearance number; OpenLinker reconciles the status automatically.
ksefInvoiceCorrectionFlow.title: Issue KOR correction

ksefInvoiceDetailSection.art108gHint: Art. 108g: include this KSeF number in the bank-transfer title when paying this invoice.
ksefInvoiceDetailSection.upoDialogDesc: Official confirmation (UPO) for this KSeF invoice.
ksefInvoiceDetailSection.upoDownloadFailedDesc: Could not fetch the confirmation document.
ksefInvoiceDetailSection.upoPreviewFailedDesc: Could not fetch the confirmation document.
ksefInvoiceDetailSection.upoPreviewUnsupported: This confirmation can't be previewed inline. Use "Download UPO" to open it.
ksefInvoiceDetailSection.verificationPendingFrame: Verification code appears once KSeF assigns the number
ksefInvoiceDetailSection.verificationPendingHint: KSeF has received this invoice and has not assigned its number yet. OpenLinker checks for it automatically; the code appears here once the number is assigned.
ksefInvoiceDetailSection.verificationPendingNotSent: This invoice has not reached KSeF yet. The code appears here once KSeF accepts it and assigns its number.

ksefInvoiceIssueOptions.lead: Nothing here is set for you. Tick only what applies to this sale; your accountant knows best.
ksefInvoiceIssueOptions.splitPaymentHint: Usually needed for goods listed in annex 15 when the invoice is over 15 000 PLN gross.

ksefNumberingActions.description: Sequential numbers OpenLinker stamps on every KSeF invoice.
ksefNumberingActions.title: Invoice numbering

dialog.description: Record the written explanation (oświadczenie o pominięciu numeru) for sequence <num>{seq}</num>. This is kept with the numbering audit for your tax records.
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Draft abandoned before submission; number never issued.
dialog.reasonRequired: Enter a reason before recording the explanation.
dialog.title: Explain numbering gap

toast.description: The oświadczenie for number {seq} was saved.
toast.title: Explanation recorded

empty.message: Create a numbering series first - the audit shows its allocated-vs-issued sequence.
empty.title: No series to audit

noEntries.message: This series has not allocated any numbers yet.
noEntries.title: No entries

noGaps.message: This series has no numbering gaps.
noGaps.title: No gaps

ksefNumberingAuditTab.summary: <num>{issued}</num> issued · <num>{gaps}</num> gaps (<num>{explained}</num> explained) · <num>{abandoned}</num> abandoned · <num>{skipped}</num> skipped · <num>{pending}</num> pending

documentTypeChanged.body: This series may already be routed to a document type. Changing it can leave that route pointing at a series that no longer matches. Recheck document routing after saving.
documentTypeChanged.title: Changing the document type

lowering.body: Lowering the next number can reproduce a number you have already issued. Only do this when migrating from another system.
lowering.title: Lowering the next number

patternChanged.body: This series has already issued numbers. A new pattern changes the format only for numbers going forward, on every connection routed to this series.
patternChanged.title: Changing an in-use pattern

fiscalYearStart.description: Governs the {token} variable. A fiscal year is labelled by the calendar year it starts in; leave at January for {token} = calendar year.
fiscalYearStart.label: Fiscal year starts in

nextSeq.description: Where the series continues from. Issued numbers are permanent and gap-sensitive, and the series is shared across every routed connection.
nextSeq.label: Next number

pattern.description: {token} is required; everything else is literal text. The series is shared, so a change applies to every connection routed to it.
pattern.label: Pattern

register.description: Optional scope; leave blank for the default.
register.label: Register / entity

corrected.hint: Correcting invoices - kept on their own series so a correction never reuses the original number.
corrected.label: Correction

ksefNumberingPage.description: Numbering series are shared across every connection; this page controls which series each document type on this connection is routed to.
ksefNumberingPage.title: Invoice numbering

announce.validOverLimit: Renders as {number}, over the maximum length

ksefNumberingPreview.caption: Renders from the invoice's issue date (preview assumes today) · {timeZone} · {reset}
ksefNumberingPreview.meterOverLimit: {length} / {max} characters - too long for the KSeF invoice-number field

addForm.seriesRequired: Choose a series for the new route.

ksefNumberingRoutingCard.heading: Numbering routing
ksefNumberingRoutingCard.intro: Choose which series numbers each KSeF document type on this connection. A route can be refined by register, currency, and source; the most specific matching route wins.

nudge.body: Assign a series to a document type below to start numbering.
nudge.title: Series created

resolution.heading: Resolution order
resolution.intro: For an example document, the most specific matching route wins; unmatched axes are dropped in order (source, then currency, then register) until a route matches.
resolution.none: No route matches this example - issuing would fail with "no numbering series". Add a default route for this document type.

errors.fiscalYearStart: Fiscal year start must be a month between 1 and 12.
errors.nextSeq: Next number must be a whole number of at least 1.
errors.padding: Padding must be a whole number between 0 and {max}.

empty.message: Create a series before issuing invoices - KSeF needs a unique, sequential number for every document.
empty.title: No numbering series yet

ksefNumberingSeriesTab.heading: Series
ksefNumberingSeriesTab.subtitle: Shared across every connection; routing below is per-connection.

authType.description: How OpenLinker authenticates the KSeF session.
authType.label: Authentication type

beforeYouStart.body: Generate a KSeF authorization token (or register a qualified electronic seal) for your seller context in the chosen KSeF environment. The secret is stored securely on the server and shown only once below.
beforeYouStart.title: Before you start

contextIdentifier.description: Optional KSeF subject/context identifier for display and future scoping. Does not affect authentication - sessions always authenticate in the seller NIP context.

createdWithWarnings.title: Connection created, with something to check

environment.description: KSeF target environment. Use Test/Demo for sandboxes; Production clears live invoices.

lineUnit.description: Unit of measure stamped on issued-invoice lines. Clear it to omit the unit from documents.

name.description: A label to identify this e-invoicing connection in OpenLinker.
name.label: Connection name

secret.description: The KSeF authorization token or qualified-seal reference. Write-only - stored securely and never shown again.
secret.label: Authentication secret

ksefSetupPage.description: Provide your KSeF environment, seller context, and authentication secret. OpenLinker uses them to clear invoices through the Polish national e-invoicing system.
ksefSetupPage.title: Connect KSeF

ksefSetupSchema.countryIso2: Country must be a 2-letter ISO code (e.g. PL)
ksefSetupSchema.lineUnitMax: Default line unit must be at most 20 characters.
ksefSetupSchema.nipChecksum: Seller NIP has an invalid checksum
ksefSetupSchema.postalCode: Postal code must use the PL format NN-NNN.

contextIdentifier.description: Optional KSeF subject/context identifier when issuing on behalf of a sub-unit.

crossBorder.description: OpenLinker cannot choose the WDT / export / OSS band for a foreign buyer by itself. Turn this on only if your catalogue already carries the right rate for those sales; without it such invoices are refused before sending.
crossBorder.label: Allow cross-border invoices

environment.description: KSeF target environment. Production clears live invoices.

exemptionKind.description: Used on invoices with VAT-exempt (zw) lines.
exemptionKind.label: Exemption grounds cite

exemptionText.description: The provision you rely on, e.g. art. 113 ust. 1 ustawy o VAT. Up to 256 characters.
exemptionText.label: Exemption grounds
exemptionText.missing: No exemption grounds are set. Invoices with exempt lines will cite the generic text "{text}", which names no provision.

lineUnit.description: Unit of measure stamped on issued-invoice lines. Clear it to omit the unit from documents.

ksefStructuredSection.nipLooksOdd: This NIP passes the checksum but does not look like a typical NIP. Check it; KSeF decides when the first invoice is sent.

paymentMethod.description: Emitted as Platnosc/FormaPlatnosci. Optional - omit to leave payment info off issued invoices.
paymentMethod.label: Default payment method

paymentTerm.description: Emitted as Platnosc/TerminPlatnosci/TerminOpis (days from the issue date). Optional; max 999.
paymentTerm.label: Default payment term (days)

skontoAmount.description: Emitted as Platnosc/Skonto/WysokoscSkonta. Optional; required together with the discount conditions.
skontoAmount.label: Early-payment discount amount

skontoConditions.description: Emitted as Platnosc/Skonto/WarunkiSkonta. Optional; required together with the discount amount.
skontoConditions.label: Early-payment discount conditions

swift.description: Emitted as Platnosc/RachunekBankowy/SWIFT. Optional - for foreign-currency transfers.
swift.label: SWIFT

taxTreatment.intro: These describe your business, not a single sale. Every invoice from this connection starts from them; you can change any of them when issuing one by hand. OpenLinker does not decide what applies to you.

oswiadczenie.body: Oświadczam, że numer {number} w serii numeracji „{series}" został pominięty i nie został oraz nie zostanie przypisany do żadnej faktury.
oswiadczenie.bodyWithSeller: Działając w imieniu {seller}, oświadczam, że numer {number} w serii numeracji „{series}" został pominięty i nie został oraz nie zostanie przypisany do żadnej faktury.
oswiadczenie.continuity: Pominięcie powyższego numeru nie narusza ciągłości numeracji faktur - kolejne numery w tej serii są nadawane w sposób ciągły i chronologiczny.
oswiadczenie.sellerMissing: Uzupełnij profil sprzedawcy (nazwa, adres, NIP) w ustawieniach połączenia, aby dane sprzedawcy pojawiły się w nagłówku.
oswiadczenie.title: Oświadczenie o pominięciu numeru faktury

setupCard.description: Connect the Polish national e-invoicing system (Krajowy System e-Faktur) to clear invoices. You will need a KSeF authorization token or a qualified electronic seal.
